name: art-day
description: Discover museum paintings from Wikimedia Commons, with personal ratings, favorites and multilingual stories.

interface.longDescription: Discover museum paintings from Wikimedia Commons. Read stories, rate paintings, save favorites and explore your taste. Local desktop plugin requiring Node.js 22.13+. Optional gallery and sidebar depend on host support. Daily automation requires separate setup. No hosted service or account required.
